product_overview: EventFlow is a multi-tenant backend for managing wedding event operations, replacing spreadsheets and manual workflows with a Supabase-backed source of truth. It supports authenticated staff, scoped event access, calling and RSVP review workflows, and Excel import/export for guest data.
core_goals: Provide secure email/password authentication with cookie-based sessions
Enforce strict multi-tenant access control by event and role
Support calling queue operations and immutable call outcome logging
Enable human review and transactional commitment of RSVP extractions
Allow idempotent Excel import and structured Excel export for guest data
Ensure database-level enforcement for RLS, auditability, and append-only/protected records

features.name: Authentication and session
features.description: Allows staff and admins to sign in with email/password, establish a session cookie, and be redirected safely to the requested destination. Unauthenticated users are sent to the login page, and sessions are refreshed automatically on each request.
user_flows: GET /login with no session -> Receive 200 HTML sign-in form -> Submit credentials through the login flow -> GET /auth/callback?code=valid_code&next=/ with auth code -> Receive 307 redirect to / with session cookie set -> GET / with session cookie -> Receive 200 event picker or dashboard

GET /login?next=https://evil.example.com with no session -> Receive 200 HTML sign-in form -> Complete auth callback with malicious next target -> GET /auth/callback?code=valid_code&next=https://evil.example.com -> Receive 307 redirect to / because non-same-origin redirect targets are sanitized
GET / with no session -> Receive 307 redirect to /login -> Attempt to access staff content without authentication -> Receive redirect instead of protected HTML

features.name: Event scoping and role gating
features.description: Restricts users to the event(s) they belong to and applies role-based access control for admin, event_team, and client users. Clients can only reach their guest list screen, while non-admins are blocked from admin-only pages.
user_flows: GET /{eventCode} with an authenticated staff session for that event -> Receive 200 HTML dashboard with event counters -> GET /{eventCode}/guests -> Receive 200 HTML guest list only if role is client or permitted viewer
GET /admin/events with an authenticated admin session -> Receive 200 HTML event list and create-event form -> GET /admin/events with event_team session -> Receive 307 redirect to /

GET /{eventCode} with an authenticated user who is not a member of the event -> Receive 404 unknown event code or not-a-member response -> GET /{eventCode}/guests with non-client or unauthorized user -> Receive denied or redirected access based on role rules

features.name: Calling queue and call attempts
features.description: Lets staff claim a family for a limited time, start a call, and record one final outcome for that attempt. Call attempts are append-only in effect, with the outcome locking the record once completed.
user_flows: GET /{eventCode}/queue with a staff session -> Receive 200 HTML queue filtered by status/search -> POST /{eventCode}/queue with eventId and groupId -> Receive 200 ok and lock the family for 15 minutes -> POST /{eventCode}/call/{groupId} with attemptId and outcome=confirmed -> Receive 200 Server Action result and finalized attempt

GET /{eventCode}/queue with a staff session -> Receive 200 HTML queue -> POST /{eventCode}/queue for a group already locked by another caller -> Receive 200 friendly refusal message indicating the group is unavailable

POST /{eventCode}/call/{groupId} with invalid or missing attemptId/outcome payload -> Receive 200 or validation failure from the Server Action path, with no completed call outcome recorded -> Retry submission after outcome is already set -> Receive refusal because the attempt row is frozen after first completion

features.name: RSVP review and commit
features.description: Provides the human approval step for AI-extracted RSVP data, with confidence-banded fields and transactional acceptance into guest records. Accepted extractions become read-only, rejected extractions are marked accordingly, and manual entries follow the same audited commit path.
user_flows: GET /{eventCode}/review -> Receive 200 HTML review queue with extractions sorted and badged by confidence -> GET /{eventCode}/review/{extractionId} -> Receive 200 HTML review form with transcript and editable fields -> POST /{eventCode}/review/{extractionId} with approved payload -> Receive 200 result and commit updates to guest_groups and travel_legs in one transaction

GET /{eventCode}/call/{groupId}/review when no extraction exists -> Receive 200 HTML fallback offering manual entry -> POST /{eventCode}/call/{groupId}/manual with manual payload -> Receive 200 Server Action result and create/apply a manual extraction transactionally

POST /{eventCode}/review/{extractionId} for an extraction already accepted -> Receive 409 Already applied friendly message -> Attempt to view the accepted extraction again -> Receive 200 review screen rendered read-only with approver and timestamp
POST /{eventCode}/review/{extractionId} with an incomplete or invalid payload -> Receive validation failure or rejected action outcome -> No guest_group or travel_leg update is committed

features.name: Excel import
features.description: Imports the calling master list from Excel in an idempotent way by re-deriving row identity on the server. The import wizard previews warnings, and repeated uploads of the same file do not duplicate data.
user_flows: GET /{eventCode}/import as an admin -> Receive 200 HTML import wizard -> POST /{eventCode}/import with a parsed spreadsheet batch -> Receive 200 import result showing created, updated, and skipped counts
POST /{eventCode}/import with the same spreadsheet uploaded again -> Receive 200 import result -> Observe skipped rows because source_row_hash is unchanged and import is idempotent

GET /{eventCode}/import with an event_team session -> Receive 307 redirect for non-admins with denied=import -> Attempt POST /{eventCode}/import as non-admin -> Receive redirected or refused access with no write committed

features.name: Excel export
features.description: Generates a workbook with four sheets for admins, including hidden identifiers for safe re-import. The export is intended to support offline editing without duplicating rows on re-ingest.
user_flows: GET /admin/export as an admin -> Receive 200 HTML export panel with event picker and download controls -> Select an event and download the workbook -> Receive a workbook generated client-side with four sheets and hidden group_id/guest_id columns
GET /admin/export with an event_team session -> Receive 307 redirect to / -> No export controls or workbook download are made available

Open exported workbook and re-import edited rows through the import flow -> POST /{eventCode}/import with edited spreadsheet data -> Receive 200 result with updates keyed by hidden identifiers instead of duplicates

features.name: Database RLS and RPC surface
features.description: Exposes the PostgREST and RPC boundary that enforces tenancy, lock acquisition, and atomic RSVP application directly in the database. Client users must see zero rows from base tables, while staff and admin access is determined by event membership and role.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/guest_groups with a valid client JWT -> Receive 200 with an empty array -> GET /rest/v1/guest_groups with a staff JWT for the event -> Receive 200 GuestGroup[] limited to permitted rows

POST /rest/v1/rpc/claim_group with p_group_id and p_minutes=15 -> Receive 200 lock result and family lock established -> POST /rest/v1/rpc/claim_group again for the same locked group from a second caller -> Receive refusal because the group is already locked

POST /rest/v1/rpc/apply_rsvp_extraction with p_extraction_id and p_payload for a pending extraction -> Receive 200 updated guest_groups row and travel legs updated atomically -> POST /rest/v1/rpc/apply_rsvp_extraction for an already accepted extraction -> Receive 400 extraction already applied or 403 if caller lacks event staff access

tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, React Server Components, Server Actions)
Supabase (PostgreSQL 17, PostgREST, GoTrue auth, Row Level Security)

features.name: Authentication and session
features.description: Email/password sign-in via Supabase GoTrue. Sessions are cookie-based and refreshed by Next.js middleware on every request. The callback route exchanges an auth code for a session and sanitises the post-login redirect.

endpoints.description: Sign-in screen. Accepts an optional ?next= redirect target.
Exchanges ?code for a session cookie, then redirects to ?next=. Open-redirect guard collapses any non-same-origin path to "/".
Event picker. Redirects unauthenticated users to /login.

response_schema.200: HTML list of events the viewer belongs to

features.name: Event scoping and role gating
features.description: Every staff route is fenced by an [eventCode] path segment. Access is resolved server-side into admin / event_team / client / none. Clients are redirected to the single screen they own; non-admins are bounced from admin-only screens with a ?denied= reason.

endpoints.description: Event dashboard with counters from v_event_dashboard.

response_schema.404: Unknown event code, or viewer is not a member

endpoints.description: Client-visible guest list, reading the client_guest_profiles view. The only screen a client role can reach.
All events plus the create-event form. Admin only.

features.name: Calling queue and call attempts
features.description: Staff claim a family for 15 minutes via the claim_group RPC, dial with a tel: link, and log one outcome. call_attempts is append-only with one-shot completion - once outcome goes non-null the row freezes permanently and identity columns are force-restored on any further update.

endpoints.description: Calling queue from v_rsvp_queue, with status and search filters.
Next.js Server Action (claimGroupForCall). Invoked as a POST to the page URL carrying a Next-Action header. Locks a family to the caller for 15 minutes; a second caller must be refused.

response_schema.200: Server Action result - ok or a friendly refusal message

endpoints.description: Server Actions startCallAttempt and submitCallOutcome. The attempt row is written before the dial fires; the outcome is written once, at the end, and freezes the row.

body.outcome: confirmed | declined | no_answer | callback | wrong_number | other

features.name: RSVP review and commit
features.description: The human gate between AI extraction and guest data. Fields are banded by confidence - at or above 0.85 normal, 0.60 to 0.85 amber, below 0.60 red and deliberately blank. Saving calls apply_rsvp_extraction, which updates guest_groups and travel_legs in one transaction, releases the caller lock, and refuses to apply an already-accepted extraction.

endpoints.description: Extractions awaiting review, badged by lowest confidence.
The review screen. Renders prior values, confidence-banded editable fields, and the transcript. An accepted extraction renders read-only with the approver name and timestamp.

response_schema.404: Unknown extraction, or not visible under RLS

endpoints.description: Group-keyed entry point. Resolves the group's outstanding extraction and redirects to its review screen; offers manual entry when none.

Server Actions acceptExtraction and rejectExtraction. Accept calls the apply_rsvp_extraction RPC with the payload the human approved. Reject updates status to rejected only when the row is still pending.

response_schema.409: Already applied - RPC raises, surfaced as a friendly message

endpoints.description: Server Action applyManualEntry. Inserts a model='manual' extraction and applies it through the same RPC, so manual entry is transactional and auditable rather than a direct table write.

features.name: Excel import
features.description: Parses the calling master list, previews it with a warning list, and writes idempotently. Row identity is a hash of head name, primary mobile and group code, unique per event, so re-running the same file changes nothing.

endpoints.description: Import wizard. Admin only; event_team is bounced with ?denied=import.
Server Action committing a parsed batch. Re-derives the row hash server-side rather than trusting the client's, and creates a guests row for every family head.

response_schema.200: Import result with created, updated and skipped counts

features.name: Excel export
features.description: Four sheets in one workbook, generated client-side. Every row carries group_id and guest_id in hidden columns so an edited sheet re-imports by id instead of duplicating. Mobiles and dates are written as text cells.

endpoints.description: Event picker, then row counts and download controls. Admin only.

features.name: Database RLS and RPC surface
features.description: Supabase PostgREST is directly reachable and is the real enforcement boundary. Every table is fenced by event_id via app.is_staff(). Child tables use composite foreign keys so a row cannot reference a parent in another event. delivery_proofs is insert-only with unconditional block triggers on update and delete; recorded_at is always overwritten with the server clock.

endpoints.description: Returns only rows in events the caller is staff on. A client-role login must receive an empty array, not an error.
Locks a family for p_minutes, default 15. Second caller must be refused.
The only sanctioned path from AI output into guest data. Updates group and legs together, clears the lock, and raises if the extraction was already accepted.

response_schema.403: Caller is not staff on the extraction's event

known_limitations.issue: Almost the entire write surface is Next.js Server Actions, not REST endpoints. They are POSTs to page URLs carrying a Next-Action header and an opaque build-specific action id, so they cannot be invoked by URL alone. Black-box HTTP testing will reach the GET routes and the Supabase REST API, but not the Server Actions directly.
known_limitations.impact: Backend coverage via HTTP is limited to route handlers, page GETs and PostgREST. Server Action logic must be exercised through the UI.

known_limitations.issue: service_role has no grants on public.profiles
known_limitations.impact: Server-side tooling using the service key cannot read or update profiles; PostgREST returns 42501 permission denied.

known_limitations.issue: apply_rsvp_extraction only ever updates the oldest leg per direction
known_limitations.impact: A group with two arrival legs will never see the second one updated.

known_limitations.issue: apply_rsvp_extraction blocks re-applying accepted extractions only
known_limitations.impact: A rejected or superseded extraction can still be applied.

known_limitations.issue: No date-range exclusion on room assignments
known_limitations.impact: Capacity is enforced by trigger against active assignments only. Two guests in the same room on non-overlapping dates both count against capacity.

known_limitations.issue: client_guest_profiles runs as owner and bypasses base-table RLS
known_limitations.impact: Its where app.is_member(event_id) clause is the only tenancy fence on that view.
